report_list: Unbilled Report Due to No Insurance
observations:
Verification: third-reader pass over all 13 original screenshots, all 13 pre-rendered list / criteria zooms and about 70 extra crops at 3x-9x. Readers A and B agreed on every report, section, control, option, default and enabled state (13 reports, 85 sections, 130 controls); their only differences were descriptive wording. Everything was re-checked on the pixels: blue-mark detection for every selected radio and ticked checkbox, a census of every input box by fill and border colour, a census of every section header bar (full-width or split in two), an ink-blob map and a light-colour histogram of each criteria area, and contrast-stretched renders. No control, icon, note or greyed element exists outside those listed here.

Coverage: 13 screenshots = 13 different reports, one screenshot each, in list order (1.PNG Claims List, 2 Capitation Utilization, 3 Claims Created Not Sent, 4 Procedures on Hold, 5 DPS Eligibility Report, 6 Capitation Payment, 7 Benefits Used/Unused = left column; 8 Outstanding Claims, 9 Claims Not Created, 10 Unbilled Report Due to No Insurance, 11 EOB 835 Claims Reconcile Report, 12 835 Denial Report, 13 RTE Sweep Details = right column). The selected radio of every screenshot was located from the pixels. Every listed report has a screenshot. No screenshot shows a popup, an expanded dropdown, a scrolled second view or a foreign screen, so the contents of every SELECT / SEARCH dialog (office, office group, provider, carriers, responsible party type, reason code, name search) and the other values of the Fee Schedule To Compare dropdown are NOT documented by these screenshots. Only one state per report was captured, so the non-default states (Pre-Authorization, Office Group, Summary, Recall, Include UCR ticked, Appointment Created Date / Both, DOS Date / Transaction Date, By File Received on Date, PDF on 835 Denial Report) are not shown.

Screen chrome (pixel-identical in all 13): dark title bar with 'Insurance Reports' at the left and 'PGID :2829 / OID :108' followed by a white printer icon at the far right. Blue sub-header 'SELECT REPORT' over the left panel and 'REPORT CRITERIA' over the right panel; the right end of the REPORT CRITERIA bar holds the grey-styled CLEAR CRITERIA button (refresh icon) - grey is its normal look in every screenshot, not a disabled state. A splitter / collapse handle (three vertical dots on an arrow-shaped tab) sits on the border between the two panels. The action bar at the bottom of the criteria panel holds the blue buttons PRINT / PREVIEW (printer icon) and ADD TO MY FAVORITES (plus icon); Outstanding Claims alone adds CREATE TASK (plus icon) to their left. No footer text: below the panels there are only uniform window-edge strips.

Report list: 13 radio entries in a two-column grid (7 in the left column, 6 in the right; the cell under RTE Sweep Details is empty). The dark panel below the grid is empty and there is no scrollbar, so the list is not scrollable or clipped. The list text is pixel-identical in all 13 screenshots. Casing as displayed: 'Procedures on Hold' and 'Unbilled Report Due to No Insurance' use lower-case 'on' / 'to'.

Text-rendering caveat: the bold section-header font draws a capital G almost exactly like a C at this resolution, so the header pixels look like 'OFFICE/CROUP', 'DATE RANCE', 'NAME RANCE', 'CROUP BY', 'DPS ELICIBILITY', '835 CLAIM MATCHINC STATUS', 'UPCOMINC'. The mixed-case label 'Office Group' on every report shows a clear G and the same rendering was resolved the same way in the other categories, so these headers are transcribed with G (OFFICE/GROUP, DATE RANGE, NAME RANGE, GROUP BY, DPS ELIGIBILITY, 835 CLAIM MATCHING STATUS, UPCOMING). The date digits '11' also render like 'TI' (the value is 11/21/2026).

Recurring patterns: PRINT FORMAT (PDF | Excel) is on all 13 reports - PDF selected on 12, Excel on 835 Denial Report; its position varies (full-width first section on 6 reports, right column of row 1 on 5, last section on Claims List, bottom-left on Outstanding Claims). REPORT FORMAT (Detail | Summary) appears only on Capitation Utilization (enabled, Detail) and 835 Denial Report (both radios greyed, Detail marked). OFFICE/GROUP (Office | Office Group radios, default Office, plus an unlabelled read-only box with a SELECT button, building icon) is on all 13; the box shows 108 (= the OID in the title bar) on 12 reports and ALL on 835 Denial Report. A PROVIDER picker (row label Provider, ALL, SELECT with single-person icon) is on 5 reports: Capitation Utilization, Claims Created Not Sent, DPS Eligibility Report, Benefits Used/Unused, Outstanding Claims. A CARRIER picker (row label Carriers, ALL, SELECT with single-person icon) is on 7 reports: Claims List, Capitation Utilization, Claims Created Not Sent, Capitation Payment, Outstanding Claims, EOB 835 Claims Reconcile Report, 835 Denial Report. GROUP BY (None | Provider, default None) is on 3 reports: Capitation Utilization, Claims Created Not Sent, Outstanding Claims - none of them has a Page Break checkbox or any other right-edge control. NAME RANGE (Start Name AAAAA / End Name ZZZZZ, each an editable-style box with its own SEARCH button, magnifier icon) is on Claims List and Claims Created Not Sent. CLAIM AMOUNT OVER OR EQUAL TO (0.00) is on Claims List, Claims Created Not Sent and Outstanding Claims; CLAIM/PRE-AUTH and CLAIM SENT TYPE are on Claims List and Outstanding Claims. The title CLAIM TYPE is used with two meanings: Both | Dental | Medical radios (Claims List, Claims Created Not Sent, Outstanding Claims) and Primary / Secondary / Tertiary / Quaternary checkboxes (Claims Not Created). OTHER OPTIONS has different content on each of the 5 reports that have it. The two 'exclude' pickers default to None: EXCLUDE RESPONSIBLE PARTY TYPE (person-plus icon) on Benefits Used/Unused and EXCLUDE REASON CODE (building icon) on 835 Denial Report.

Date sections: a Start Date / End Date range titled DATE RANGE on Claims List, Capitation Utilization, Procedures on Hold, Capitation Payment, Unbilled Report Due to No Insurance, EOB 835 Claims Reconcile Report (preceded there by a By Payment Date | By File Received on Date radio) and 835 Denial Report; titled CREATED ON DATE RANGE on Claims Created Not Sent and RTE Sweep Details; APPOINTMENT DATE RANGE plus APPOINTMENT CREATED DATE RANGE switched by DATE RANGE TYPE on DPS Eligibility Report; ANNIVERSARY DATE RANGE on Benefits Used/Unused. A single Report Date titled REPORT DATE is used on Outstanding Claims and on Claims Not Created (preceded there by an ALL | DOS Date | Transaction Date radio). All date fields are MM/DD/YYYY boxes with a calendar icon and show 11/21/2026 (the capture day, i.e. the default is today), except Benefits Used/Unused (12/01/2026 to 11/30/2027 = first day of the next month to one year later minus a day).

Enabled / disabled states were confirmed by pixel colour: editable fields have fill 241,241,241; read-only picker boxes and disabled fields have fill 220,223,226; disabled labels are mid-grey (161) against black for enabled ones. Controls greyed in the captured default states (what enables them is inferred, never shown): the Fee Schedule To Compare dropdown on Capitation Utilization (Include UCR unticked); both APPOINTMENT CREATED DATE RANGE dates on DPS Eligibility Report (DATE RANGE TYPE = Appointment Date); Report Date on Claims Not Created (radio = ALL); both REPORT FORMAT radios on 835 Denial Report (Excel selected). All SELECT and SEARCH buttons are blue (enabled) in every screenshot.

Truncation: the criteria area has a fixed height (about 481 px in every screenshot) with the action bar pinned below it, and no scrollbar is drawn anywhere. In all 13 screenshots the first section header is fully visible at the top and blank panel background separates the last section from the action bar (smallest gap about 27 px, under GROUP BY on Capitation Utilization), so no report is flagged possibly_truncated.

supplement_unresolved.question: `Include Resolved Claims`: the effect is not documented; the research document only infers that it adds closed claims and that by default only unresolved claims are listed.

Older build: the vendor's 2011 sample footer echoes `Provider : ALL`, but the current criteria have no PROVIDER picker. An older build apparently filtered Claims List by provider; it is NOT added because the current screen (captured complete) does not have it. Whether the filter was removed or is only hidden in the current build is not documented.

`CLAIM TYPE` (`Both` / `Dental` / `Medical`) on Claims List, Claims Created Not Sent and Outstanding Claims: that it filters dental versus medical claims is inferred (on Outstanding Claims the research document only presumes a separate `Medical Claims` band).
`Show Billing Provider For Hygienist`: not documented; taken (inferred) to print the billing provider instead of a hygienist in the provider column.

`FACILITY ID`: the vendor sample header prints `Facility ID : <value>`; that the criteria text box supplies that header line (the carrier's id for the office) is inferred. The basis of `DATE RANGE` (transaction date of the procedures) is also inferred from the sample.
`Fee Schedule To Compare`: which fee schedules the list contains (all of the practice or only those of the selected office), their order and the rule for the pre-selected entry are not documented.

`REPORT FORMAT` = `Summary`: what it changes is not documented (the vendor sample and the old report name `Capitation Utilization - Detail` cover Detail only). `GROUP BY` = `Provider`: taken (inferred) to add a provider level.
Whether PRINT FORMAT = Excel also greys GROUP BY on Capitation Utilization and on Claims Created Not Sent, as it does on Outstanding Claims, is not documented.

No vendor article names this report. Open: the date basis of CREATED ON DATE RANGE (date the claim was created is our reading), whether the other criteria behave as on Claims List (inferred) and what GROUP BY = Provider does (a provider level is inferred). Also unverified: whether a claim saved with `E-Claim` (ledger text `Recreated` instead of `Created, Not Sent`) is included.
Whether `DATE RANGE` is the date of service or the transaction date is unverified.

`On Hold`: that ticking it limits the report to requests flagged On Hold on the verification form is inferred; `Include patients with no insurance` (adds appointments of patients with no plan attached) is inferred too. The report itself is not described by the vendor.

`DATE RANGE TYPE`: the non-default states (Appointment Created Date, Both) are not shown by the vendor. That they enable the greyed APPOINTMENT CREATED DATE RANGE inputs, and which range each choice disables, remains an inference from our screenshot.
The basis of `DATE RANGE` (payment date) is inferred.

Older build / unseen mode: Recall mode was not captured, and its criteria are known only from an older build: the footer of the vendor's 2011 Recall sample (then the separate report `Benefits Used/Unused - Recall`) echoes three criteria that the Treatment Plan state does not have - `Recall Date From / Thru`, `Max Over` and `Recall Codes`. They are NOT added as controls: the current Recall screen is unverified, and the footer wording gives neither the section titles nor the on-screen labels, control types, value lists or defaults. To settle: capture the screen with TREATMENT PLAN/RECALL = Recall and record which criteria appear, change or disappear.
`EXCLUDE RESPONSIBLE PARTY TYPE`: the value list of the picker is not documented.

OTHER OPTIONS `Current` / `Over 30` / `Over 60` / `Over 90` / `Over 120`: that they choose which age buckets are included is inferred. Also unknown: the age basis (claim sent date or date of service) and whether `Report Date` reconstructs history or only shifts the aging.

`GROUP BY` = `Provider`: taken (inferred) to add a provider grouping level. Vendor material still uses the old report name `Outstanding Claim Report for Provider`; mapping it to this option is inferred.

`REPORT DATE`: that `DOS Date` / `Transaction Date` enable the single Report Date input (and that `ALL` means every unclaimed procedure) comes from our own screenshot; the vendor documents only single-day use. `CLAIM TYPE` Primary / Secondary / Tertiary / Quaternary (coverage levels whose missing claims are listed) is inferred.
The basis of `DATE RANGE` is unverified.

`Show Details UCR` (ticked by default): not documented; taken (unverified) to add service-line detail with the billed (UCR) amount. The meanings of `835 CLAIM MATCHING STATUS` (payment matched to a claim or not) and of `CLAIM STATUS` `Partial Closed` / `Closed` (claim state after posting) are inferred.

`EXCLUDE REASON CODE`: the effect (removes lines with the picked reason codes) is inferred and the value list of the picker is not documented (sample values suggest the standard 835 adjustment reason codes - inferred).
The report is not described by the vendor: what `CREATED ON DATE RANGE` filters (taken to be the date-time of the automatic eligibility check) is inferred.

ADD TO MY FAVORITES (action on every report): vendor training material says it saves the criteria - one version per report - and that a saved version is later changed with `Update My Favorites`. Where `Update My Favorites` appears (this button relabelled once the report is a favourite, or an action elsewhere) is not described in this document.

SELECT / SEARCH dialogs: apart from `Include All` (stated for the PROVIDER and CARRIER pickers and, generally, for all pickers) and the fact that one or more offices or an office group can be chosen, the contents of the office / office group, provider, carrier, responsible-party-type and reason-code dialogs and of the NAME RANGE SEARCH lookups are not described in this research document.
